name: Engineering Acoustics & Noise Control
summary: Sound generation, propagation and measurement, and the practical engineering of quieter machines, products and buildings.

topics.name: The acoustic wave equation; plane and spherical waves
Decibels: sound pressure, intensity and power levels; combining sources
Frequency analysis, octave bands and A-/C-weighting
Human hearing, noise criteria and regulations; hearing conservation
Sound measurement: microphones, sound level meters, intensity probes
Room acoustics: reverberation time, absorption and the Sabine equation
Sound transmission loss through walls and enclosures
Machinery noise sources: fans, gears, motors, flow noise and impacts
Noise control at source, path and receiver; damping treatments
HVAC system noise and vibration control
Active noise control and sound quality
